## Research Overview

My research develops data-driven and AI-enabled methods for smart manufacturing systems. I work at the intersection of industrial engineering, time-series analytics, machine learning, deep learning, and collaborative manufacturing intelligence, with an emphasis on methods that can support real manufacturing decisions.

The central goal of my work is to help manufacturing systems use data more effectively: to forecast system behavior, classify events, detect quality issues, support predictive maintenance, coordinate distributed decision-making, and improve resilience across production and supply-network environments.

## Core Questions

- How can manufacturing time-series data be transformed into reliable decision support?
- How should AI and machine learning algorithms be evaluated for industrial use rather than only benchmark performance?
- How can deep learning models support forecasting, classification, predictive maintenance, and quality improvement in real manufacturing systems?
- How can federated learning and blockchain support secure collaborative analytics across organizations?
- How can agentic AI, multi-agent systems, and digital twins support smart manufacturing operations?

## Research Themes

### Time-Series Analytics for Smart Manufacturing

Manufacturing systems generate high-frequency, multivariate, and heterogeneous time-series data. My work studies forecasting, classification, anomaly detection, and pattern recognition methods that help translate these streams into process insight and operational decisions.

Related work includes research on time-series forecasting, time-series classification, high-resolution classification, and time-series pattern recognition in smart manufacturing systems.

### Industrial AI and Machine Learning

I apply machine learning to manufacturing problems such as process monitoring, predictive maintenance, quality prediction, and defect detection. This includes both model development and experimental evaluation of algorithms in realistic industrial settings.

This theme connects to projects on real-time defect detection, robotic assembly, directed energy deposition additive manufacturing, and hybrid physics-based/data-driven modeling.

### Deep Learning for Manufacturing Analytics

My research uses deep learning for forecasting, classification, predictive maintenance, and quality improvement. I am interested in models that can handle temporal dependencies, noisy measurements, and changing manufacturing conditions.

Current work includes deep learning architectures for manufacturing time-series forecasting and classification, including collaborative settings where data is distributed across partners.

### Agentic AI and Multi-Agent Systems

I study Agentic AI and multi-agent systems for decision support in manufacturing. This includes exploring how autonomous and semi-autonomous agents can support diagnosis, planning, maintenance, and coordination across complex production environments.

This direction examines how agent-based intelligence can complement human expertise and existing industrial systems.

### Digital Twins and Digital Supply Networks

Digital twins and digital supply networks can connect physical operations with analytical models, simulation, and system-level visibility. My work explores how these technologies can support manufacturing resilience, collaboration, and performance improvement.

Related work includes digital twin enabled robot monitoring and time-series forecasting for collision detection.

### Federated Learning and Blockchain for Secure Collaboration

I study privacy-preserving and trustworthy collaborative AI frameworks for smart manufacturing. This includes federated learning and blockchain-enabled approaches for sharing model intelligence across organizations without exposing sensitive manufacturing data.

This theme supports a broader research direction in secure digital supply networks and collaborative manufacturing analytics.

## Current Directions

- **Agentic AI for smart manufacturing:** studying how agentic AI and multi-agent systems can support planning, diagnosis, coordination, and decision support.
- **Secure collaborative manufacturing analytics:** integrating federated learning, blockchain, and deep learning for privacy-preserving industrial AI.
- **Digital twins and robotic systems:** using time-series forecasting and digital twin models for robot monitoring and collision detection.
- **Practical AI/ML guidance for industry:** developing applied guidance for manufacturing organizations adopting time-series analytics, machine learning, and deep learning.
